params.description: This card becomes a space where livestock can be kept. Different types allowed. Capacity equals number of pastures on farm. After each harvest breeding phase, gain 1 food per unused capacity slot on this card.

effects.notes: Card acts as additional pasture space; capacity = number of pastures on farm. After each harvest breeding phase, gain 1 food per unused slot.

post_play.notes: Stays in play area as a persistent card providing livestock space
